propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls the same nextPageToken cursor loop three times with no runaway-cursor guard, allowing a server that repeats the same token to spin forever (cabc failure mode).

A shared cursor pagination iterator with a runaway guard must terminate on isLast:true or absent token, and raise RunawayPaginationError when the server returns the same non-null token twice consecutively.
The RunawayPaginationError must escape the fail-open exception handlers in each map reader to prevent silent partial results; ordinary transport exceptions continue to degrade gracefully.
All three acli_graph maps must consume the shared cursor iterator with no residual hand-rolled loops, verified by structural test assertion.
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages and jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain untouched and independent; cursor and offset pagination are separate protocol paths.
